[[File:Mario.png|thumb|250px|Mario]] '''Mario''' (Japanese: '''モブオ''' ''Mobuo'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP146|Dressed for Jess Success!]]''. He is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]]. Mario competed in the [[Lilypad Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]], hoping to win the [[Ribbon]] with his {{p|Granbull}}. He passed through the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]], but he lost against {{an|Dawn}} and her {{TP|Dawn|Mamoswine}} in the quarterfinals. {{-}} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Mario's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mario |pkmn=Granbull |type1=Normal |img=Mario Granbull.png |epnum=DP146 |epname=Dressed for Jess Success! |desc=Mario's {{p|Granbull}} went up against {{an|Dawn}} and her {{TP|Dawn|Mamoswine}} during the [[Contest Battle|Battle Round]] of the {{to|Lilypad}} {{pkmn|Contest}}. Although Granbull seemed to be very powerful, it was unable to stand up to Mamoswine's newly learned {{m|Ice Shard}} and {{m|Hidden Power}} [[Contest combination|combination]], and was quickly knocked out. Granbull's only known move is {{m|Fire Fang}}.}} ==Contests== Mario has competed in the following [[Pokémon Contest]]s: * {{to|Lilypad}} Contest - Top 8 (''[[DP146|Dressed for Jess Success!]]'') ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=阪口大助 ''[[Daisuke Sakaguchi]]'' |en=[[Tom Wayland]] |es_eu=Eduardo del Hoyo |fi=Petrus Kähkönen |fr_eu=Grégory Praet |cs=Ladislav Cigánek |pt_br=Douglas Guedes |pl=Tomasz Robaczewski}}
